meta.promptText: Which brand's kurta sets should I buy for women online in India?

response.text:
For **online kurta sets in India**, the best brand depends on what you want most: **Libas** for variety and everyday wear, **W for Woman** for office-ready sets, **Biba** for classic festive wear, and **Jaipur Kurti** for affordable printed options.[1][2][11][13][19]

If you want a quick shortlist:

- **Libas** — strongest all-round choice for **daily wear, trendy styles, and a wide range of kurta sets**.[1][2][15]
- **W for Woman** — good for **workwear and coordinated ethnic sets**.[1][13]
- **Biba** — reliable for **festive classics and family functions**.[1][19]
- **Jaipur Kurti** — good if you want **budget-friendly printed kurta sets**.[1][11]
- **House of Indya** — better for **festive, fashion-forward designs**.[1][20]
- **Aachho** — good for **printed festive kurta sets** and mid-range pricing.[1][4]

If you want just one recommendation without more context, **Libas** is the safest default because it has broad online variety across straight cotton, A-line, Anarkali, woven, and festive embroidered sets.[1][2]

If you tell me your **budget** and whether you want **daily wear, office wear, or festive wear**, I can narrow it down to the best 2–3 brands for you.
